mentions.name: Hotlap Daily
mentions.description: A free mini-game for Formula 1 enthusiasts, built entirely with Claude Sonnet 4 and hosted on AWS. It consistently gets about 30k visits per month with daily peaks up to 10k, and multiplayer support is being considered as a new feature based on user requests.
mentions.audience: F1 (Formula 1) enthusiasts who play the daily game
